about: The most issues of each rule graph:check --budget allows, in two parts: legacy is Units 1 to 12, the Reference shelf and course-wide issues, at the counts the conversion left, which can only go down (graph:check --lower-budget); new is Unit 13 onward, where every rule is at zero, so a module written in a new unit is never hidden by the old units (ledger ruling 2026-11-25). A rule a part does not name has a budget of 0.
